queries.title: 净销售额
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000
